evals.prompt: Our AMC overlap query (Q3 2026) shows shoppers who saw both DSP and Sponsored Products ads converted at 4.1% vs 1.2% for SP-only. Notes that the combined group's rate describes shoppers already reached, so extra DSP spend buys less-engaged shoppers at rising cost (diminishing returns). Checks conversion maturity and matched windows. Proposes a holdout or controlled test of DSP's incremental contribution with a primary metric and guardrails, does not invent lift numbers, and uses no empty template cards for this advice question.

assertions.condition: Does not claim to have run the sizing query or created the audience; running sizing or creating the audience waits for the user's explicit approval.

assertions.name: size-minimum-check
assertions.condition: Checks the estimated size against a minimum audience size before activation and says what to widen (window or ASIN scope) if it falls short.

assertions.name: bid-boost-semantics
assertions.condition: Explains that a Sponsored Products audience bid boost raises bids where the campaign's existing targeting matches and doesn't restrict who sees the ads.

assertions.name: answer-first
assertions.condition: The reply opens with a short answer and the audience SQL comes before any readiness section, definition card, or list of questions.

assertions.name: audience-matches-request
assertions.condition: The default audience covers shoppers who added to cart regardless of ad exposure, or the reply explicitly explains the trade-off of restricting it to shoppers the ads reached and offers the switch.

assertions.name: plain-language-labels
assertions.condition: User-facing prose (outside code blocks, YAML cards, and approval previews) contains none of the internal codes ACCOUNT_FACT, CURRENT_POLICY, EXTERNAL_BENCHMARK, HYPOTHESIS, or READY_FOR_*; evidence is stated in plain words, and the verdict is stated in plain words (a verdict code in parentheses right after it is allowed).

assertions.name: length-fit
assertions.condition: The reply is 1,600 words or fewer (wc -w).
